answer: Sybils are cheap: identities are free, so charge rent. A new agent escrows a bond in a shared vault before invoicing, worth three payouts, so a thousand fake IDs cost a thousand real deposits. Reputation isn't self-reported but a mirror of settled invoices co-signed by the client and hashed to the vault ledger, so fresh accounts read empty. Graduation means climbing a graded knoll: five audits by random peers who re-run it; one failure forfeits half the bond to reviewers. It breaks if bonds share one pool, so cap linked funding and halt graduation past twenty percent audit disagreement.
